title: The Aerospace Walk of Honor
text: Lancaster's Aerospace Walk of Honor was established in 1990 to honor test pilots who flew at Edwards Air Force Base. Its first honorees in 1990 included Chuck Yeager and James H. Doolittle, and Neil Armstrong followed in 1991. The program was completed in 2009, when the 100th honoree was inducted. Sidewalk monuments along Lancaster Boulevard still honor the pilots.
